name.description: The party's name. Only present when the name is available and privacy is not enabled.

number.description: The party's number. Only present when the number is available and privacy is not enabled. The number can be digits or a URI. Some examples for number include: `1234`, `2223334444`, `+12223334444`, `*73`, and `user@company.domain`.

personId.description: The party's person ID. Only present when the person ID is available and privacy is not enabled.

placeId.description: The party's place ID. Only present when the place ID is available and privacy is not enabled.

privacyEnabled.description: if `true`, denotes privacy is enabled for the name, number and `personId`/`placeId`.
